traceability.notes: Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION is fully implemented. The `traceability/require-test-traceability` rule exists, is wired into the plugin’s rule registry and recommended/strict presets, and is covered by focused RuleTester tests. It enforces file-level @supports in test files, validates describe() descriptions with a configurable story pattern, and enforces [REQ-...] prefixes on it()/test() names with safe auto-fix for malformed prefixes. Test file detection uses the specified directory/filename patterns and is configurable. Error messages match the examples in the story, and deep validation of @supports references is provided by existing valid-story-reference and valid-req-reference rules, which are applicable to test files as well. The rule and its options are documented in the user API reference. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied based on the concrete code, tests, and documentation in the repository.
